locations_wikitext:
== Locations for unlimited supplies ==
The following vendors sell unlimited supplies of important poison-making ingredients.

* [[Concentrator Agent]]: Bartender in the [[Gnawed Noble Tavern]] in [[Denerim Market District]] and [[Bodahn Feddic]] at your [[Party Camp]]
* [[Corrupter Agent]]: [[Bodahn Feddic]] at your [[Party Camp]] and [[Alimar]] in [[Dust Town]] (If not forced to accept bribe of 10 silvers for information).
* [[Deathroot (Origins)|Deathroot]]: [[Varathorn]] at the [[Dalish Camp]] (if you side with werewolves he will be unavailable)
* [[Deep Mushroom (Origins)|Deep Mushroom]]: [[Ruck]] in Ruck's Cave in the [[Ortan Thaig]] area of The Deep Roads (if you kill him his stock will be unavailable)
* [[Distillation Agent]]: Bartender in the [[Gnawed Noble Tavern]] in [[Denerim Market District]] and [[Bodahn Feddic]] at your Party Camp
* [[Flask]]s: Bartender in the [[Gnawed Noble Tavern]] in Denerim Market District, Innkeeper at [[The Spoiled Princess]], Figor in Figor's Imports in [[Orzammar]] (you must scare off the Carta thugs first), and [[Bodahn Feddic]] at your Party Camp
* [[Lifestone]]: [[Ruck]] in Ruck's Cave in the Ortan Thaig area of The Deep Roads (if you kill him his stock will be unavailable)
* [[Lyrium Dust]]: Quartermaster in the [[Circle Tower]]
* [[Toxin Extract]]: Varathorn at the Dalish Camp (if you side with werewolves he will be unavailable)

grenades_wikitext:
== Grenades ==
{{See|[[Poison-Making recipes]] for detailed information}}

Grenades are '[[Area_of_Effect#Effects|Area of Effect]]' weapons, so [[Codex_entry:_Friendly_Fire|friendly fire]] settings apply.  Note that the second tier of the [[Stealth (Origins)|Stealth]] talent allows a Rogue to toss grenades at will (because they count as items, and therefore do not break stealth). Tier 4 grenades exist only in ''[[Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening]]''. Note that per [[Dispel Grenade]], the item is bugged and does not work.
